diagnostics.message: `:resource.google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots` grants host-project IAM roles to Google-managed service identities whose availability is tied to enabling their APIs. It has no ordering edge to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`, so the IAM grant can be attempted before those identities are provisioned. Make the grants wait for API activation.

The Shared VPC host-project operation requires the Compute API, but this resource has no ordering edge to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`. If `compute.googleapis.com` is enabled through this module, the API may not be ready when the host-project request runs.

Associating service projects with this Shared VPC host also requires the Compute API, but this resource has no ordering edge to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`. Its dependency on the host-project resource does not currently ensure API activation first.

Attaching this project as a Shared VPC service project requires the Compute API, but this resource has no ordering edge to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`. If `compute.googleapis.com` is enabled through this module, the API may not be ready when the attachment request runs.
